value.answer: Tomorrow in Windsor looks mostly sunny and hot, around 29 to 30°C. Could be a shower or a thunderstorm early in the morning, then it clears up. The afternoon is sunny at 29°C and feels like 35. The wind picks up mid-afternoon, west around 30 km/h with gusts to 50, easing by 8 pm. Showers are likely overnight, possibly with thunder.
